learning_outcomes.details: Nắm vững những nội dung về sự ra đời, các giai đoạn phát triển, đối tượng, phương pháp và ý nghĩa của việc nghiên cứu chủ nghĩa xã hội khoa học. Nắm vững được những tri thức cơ bản, cốt lõi nhất của Chủ nghĩa xã hội khoa học, một trong ba bộ phận cấu thành chủ nghĩa Mác - Lenin To master the contents regarding the emergence, stages of development, subject, methodology, and significance of studying Scientific Socialism. To firmly grasp the fundamental and core knowledge of Scientific Socialism, one of the three integral components of Marxism–Leninism.

Xây dựng kỹ năng lập luận, soạn thảo bài viết, thuyết trình, tư duy phản biện, xử lý các quan hệ xã hội và hoạt động nhóm. Xây dựng kỹ năng thích ứng, tự học, sử dụng AI có trách nhiệm, đạo đức phù hợp với quan điểm triết học, văn hóa - xã hội, lịch sử Việt Nam Develop skills of argument, writing, presentations, critical thinking, handling social relations and group activities. To build adaptability and self-learning skills, and to use AI responsibly and ethically in alignment with philosophical perspectives as well as Vietnam’s cultural, social, and historical context.
Nắm vững những nội dung của chủ nghĩa Mác – Lênin về sứ mệnh lịch sử của giai cấp công nhân Master Marxism-Leninism theory on the historical mission of the working class

Nắm vững những quan điểm của chủ nghĩa Mác – Lênin về chủ nghĩa xã hội, thời kỳ quá độ lên chủ nghĩa xã hội bỏ qua chế độ tư bản chủ nghĩa ở Việt Nam và sự vận dụng sáng tạo của Đảng Cộng sản Việt Nam vào điều kiện cụ thể Việt Nam Master the Marxist-Leninist views on socialism, the transitional period towards socialism while ignoring the capitalist regime in Vietnam and the Communist Party of Vietnam's creative application to Vietnamese practices

Nắm vững những quan điểm của chủ nghĩa Mác – Lênin về nền dân chủ xã hội chủ nghĩa và nhà nước xã hội chủ nghĩa, quan điểm của Đảng Cộng sản Việt Nam về việc xây dựng và hoàn thiện nền dân chủ và nhà nước xã hội chủ nghĩa ở Việt Nam hiện nay Master the Marxist-Leninist views on socialist democracy and the socialist state, the Communist Party of Vietnam's view on building and perfecting socialist democracy and state in Vietnam today

Nắm vững cơ cấu xã hội - giai cấp và liên minh giai cấp, tầng lớp trong thời kỳ quá độ lên chủ nghĩa xã hội Master social-class structure and alliances of class in the transitional period to socialism.

Nắm vững những quan điểm cơ bản của chủ nghĩa Mác – Lênin, đường lối, chính sách của Đảng và nhà nước Việt Nam về vấn đề dân tộc và tôn giáo Master fundamental viewpoints of Marxism-Leninism and the Vietnamese Party and State's lines and policies on ethnicity, religion issues

Nắm vững những quan điểm cơ bản của chủ nghĩa Mác – Lênin về vấn đề gia đình trong thời kỳ quá độ lên chủ nghĩa xã hội Master fundamental viewpoints of Marxism-Leninism on family problems in the transitional period to socialism

Nâng cao năng lực hiểu biết thực tiễn và khả năng vận dụng các tri thức Chủ nghĩa xã hội khoa học vào việc xem xét, đánh giá các vấn đề chính trị xã hội liên quan đến con đường đi lên chủ nghĩa xã hội của đất nước. Có thái độ chính trị đúng đắn về môn học nói riêng và nền tảng tư tưởng của Đảng nói chung. To enhance practical understanding and the ability to apply the knowledge of Scientific Socialism in examining and evaluating socio-political issues related to the country’s path toward socialism. To develop a proper political attitude toward the subject in particular and toward the ideological foundation of the Party in general.

Hình thành năng lực lý luận và ứng dụng thực tiễn, nhấn mạnh vai trò công dân và tinh thần trách nhiệm xã hội. Hình thành thế giới quan, phương pháp luận thích ứng trước sự biến đổi nhanh chóng của thời đại, khoa học công nghệ. Hiểu được tầm quan trọng của giá trị nhân văn, xã hội trong tiến trình phát triển của nhân loại. To develop reasoning competence and practical application skills, with an emphasis on civic roles and social responsibility. To foster a worldview and methodology capable of adapting to the rapid transformations of the era and advances in science and technology. To understand the significance of humanistic and social values in the development of humankind.

metadata.course_name_from_curriculum: History of Communist Party of Vietnam_Lịch sử Đảng Cộng sản Việt Nam
metadata.title: History of CPV - Lịch sử Đảng Cộng sản Việt Nam
metadata.english_title: History of CPV - Lịch sử Đảng Cộng sản Việt Nam
metadata.description:
Giới thiệu môn học: Lịch sử Đảng Cộng sản Việt Nam là một chuyên ngành, một bộ phận của khoa học lịch sử. Chủ tịch Hồ Chí Minh đã khẳng định Lịch sử Đảng Cộng sản Việt Nam là cả một pho lịch sử bằng vàng. Đó chính là tính khoa học, cách mạng, giá trị thực tiễn sâu sắc trong Cương lĩnh, đường lối của Đảng; là sự lãnh đạo đúng đắn, đáp ứng kịp thời những yêu cầu, nhiệm vụ do lịch sử đặt ra; những kinh nghiệm, bài học có tính quy luật, lý luận của cách mạng Việt Nam và những truyền thống vẻ vang của Đảng.
Nghiên cứu, học tập lịch sử Đảng không chỉ nắm vững những sự kiện, cột mốc lịch sử mà cần thấu hiểu những vấn đề phong phú đó trong quá trình lãnh đạo và đấu tranh, để vận dụng, phát triển trong thời kỳ đổi mới toàn diện, đẩy mạnh công nghiệp hóa, hiện đại hóa đất nước và hội nhập quốc tế hiện nay.
Course introduction: History of CPV is a major and a division of historical science. President Ho Chi Minh affirmed that the history of the Communist Party of Vietnam is golden pages. That is scientific, revolutionary and profound practical value in the Party's platforms and guidelines, is proper leadership and timely response to requirements and missions set by the history; is the normative and theoretical experiences and lessons of Vietnamese revolution and the glorious traditions of the Party.
Researching and studying history of CPV not only requires mastering historical events and milestones but also understanding those issues in the process of leading and struggling; thereby applying and developing in the current period of comprehensive renovation and accelerating industrialization and modernization and international integration.

Mục tiêu môn học:
- Về nội dung: Cung cấp những tri thức có tính hệ thống, cơ bản về sự ra đời của Đảng Cộng sản Việt Nam (1920- 1930), sự lãnh đạo của Đảng đối với cách mạng Việt Nam trong thời kỳ đấu tranh giành chính quyền (1930- 1945), trong hai cuộc kháng chiến chống thực dân Pháp và đế quốc Mỹ xâm lược (1945- 1975), trong sự nghiệp xây dựng, bảo vệ Tổ quốc thời kỳ cả nước quá độ lên chủ nghĩa xã hội, tiến hành công cuộc đổi mới (1975- 2018).
- Về tư tưởng: Thông qua các sự kiện lịch sử và các kinh nghiệm về sự lãnh đạo của Đảng để xây dựng ý thức tôn trọng sự thật khách quan, nâng cao lòng tự hào, niềm tin của sinh viên vào sự lãnh đạo của Đảng trong quá khứ và hiện tại.
- Về kỹ năng: Trang bị phương pháp tư duy khoa học về lịch sử, kỹ năng lựa chọn tài liệu nghiên cứu, học tập môn học và khả năng vận dụng nhận thức lịch sử vào công tác thực tiễn, phê phán quan niệm sai trái về lịch sử của Đảng.

Course Objectives:
- Knowledge: Students will understand basic and systematic knowledge of the establishment of the Communist Party of Vietnam (1920–1930); the Party’s leadership in the struggle for power (1930–1945); the Party’s leadership in the two wars against French colonialism and U.S. imperialism (1945–1975); and the Party’s leadership in the national transition to socialism and the Doi Moi reforms (1975–2018).
- Attitudes: Through historical events and experiences of the Party’s leadership, students will develop respect for objective truth, and deepen pride and confidence in the Party’s leadership in the past and present.
- Skills: Students will develop scientific thinking about history, skills in selecting research and study materials, and the ability to apply historical knowledge in practice, critically evaluate misconceptions about the Party’s history.

Nội dung môn học:
Môn học trang bị cho sinh viên những hiểu biết cơ bản về đối tượng, mục đích, nhiệm vụ, phương pháp nghiên cứu, học tập môn học Lịch sử Đảng Cộng sản Việt Nam; những kiến thức cơ bản, cốt lõi, có hệ thống về sự ra đời của Đảng (1920 - 1930), về quá trình Đảng lãnh đạo cách mạng Việt Nam từ năm 1930 cho đến nay, từ đó, khẳng định các thành công, nêu lên các hạn chế, tổng kết những kinh nghiệm về sự lãnh đạo trong thực tiễn cách mạng.
Ngoài Chương nhập môn, nội dung môn học được bố cục gồm 3 chương:
- Chương 1: Đảng Cộng sản Việt Nam ra đời và lãnh đạo đấu tranh giành chính quyền (1930 - 1945);
- Chương II: Đảng lãnh đạo hai cuộc kháng chiến, hoàn thành giải phóng dân tộc, thống nhất đất nước (1945 - 1975);
- Chương III: Đảng lãnh đạo cả nước quá độ lên Chủ nghĩa xã hội và tiến hành công cuộc đổi mới (1975 - 2018).
Qua đó khẳng định các thành công, nêu lên các hạn chế, tổng kết những kinh nghiệm về sự lãnh đạo cách mạng của Đảng để giúp người học nâng cao nhận thức, niềm tin đổi với Đảng và khả năng vận dụng kiến thức đã học vào thực tiễn công tác, góp phần xây dựng và bảo vệ Tổ quốc Việt Nam xã hội chủ nghĩa.

This course provides students with basic knowledge of objects, purposes, tasks, research and study methods of the History of CPV; the basic, core, systematic knowledge of the Party establishment (1920 - 1930), the process of the Party's leading the Vietnamese revolution from 1930 to the present, thereby, by affirming the successes, listing the limitations and summarizing experience of the Party’s leadership in revolutionary practices.
In addition to the introductory chapter, the course content includes three chapters:
- Chapter 1: The Communist Party of Vietnam was founded and led the rise to power (1930-1945);
- Chapter II: The Party led two resistance wars, completing national liberation and reunion (1945 - 1975);
- Chapter III: The Party led the national transition to socialism and carrying out the Doi moi (1975-2018).
Through this, students will recognize the achievements and identify the limitations of the Party’s revolutionary leadership, summarize the experiences gained, enhance their awareness and confidence in the Party, and develop the ability to apply the knowledge learned to practical work, contributing to the construction and defense of a socialist Vietnam.

Phương pháp dạy học: Thuyết giảng và kết hợp trình chiếu các slide bài giảng. Hướng dẫn, giao bài tập đề tài theo nhóm. Tổ chức và hướng dẫn sinh viên thảo luận nhóm, thuyết trình và thực hiện sản phẩm sáng tạo (tham khảo và ứng dụng phần mềm AI một cách có trách nhiệm).
Teaching method: Giving lectures and slide presentations. Guiding and assigning groupwork assignments. Organizing and guiding students in group discussions, presentations, and the development of creative products (with the responsible and ethical use of AI tools)

learning_outcomes.details: Hiểu được về đối tượng, mục đích, nhiệm vụ, phương pháp nghiên cứu, học tập môn học Lịch sử Đảng Cộng sản Việt Nam Understand the objects, purposes, tasks, research and study methods of the History of CPV

Phân tích sự ra đời của Đảng Cộng sản Việt Nam (1920 - 1930), sự lãnh đạo của Đảng đối với cách mạng Việt Nam trong thời kỳ đấu tranh giành chính quyền (1930 - 1945), trong hai cuộc kháng chiến chống thực dân Pháp và đế quốc Mỹ xâm lược (1945 - 1975) Analyze the establishment of the Communist Party of Vietnam (1920 - 1930), the Party's leadership over the period of Rise to power (1930 - 1945) and two resistance wars against French colonialist and American imperialist invasions (1945 - 1975)

Nắm được quá trình xây dựng và bảo vệ Tổ quốc, quá độ lên Chủ nghĩa xã hội, tiến hành công cuộc đổi mới toàn diện đất nước (1975 - 2018) của Đảng Cộng sản Việt Nam. Từ đó, khẳng định các thành công, nêu lên các hạn chế, tổng kết những kinh nghiệm về sự lãnh đạo trong thực tiễn cách mạng Understand the national construction and defense, the transition to socialism, the implementation of the comprehensive renovation of the country (1975 - 2018) of the Communist Party of Vietnam. Thereby, affirming the successes, listing the limitations and summarizing experiences on leadership in revolutionary practices.

Củng cố và nâng cao niềm tin, niềm tự hào vào sự lãnh đạo của Đảng, định hướng phấn đấu theo mục tiêu, lý tưởng của Đảng Strengthen and enhance trust and pride in the Party’s leadership, and orient students to strive toward the Party’s goals and ideals.

Củng cố, nâng cao ý thức tự rèn luyện và tu dưỡng đạo đức cách mạng; thể hiện nhận thức chính trị, tư tưởng đúng đắn trong học tập và hoạt động thực tiễn Consolidate and strengthen students’ awareness of self-discipline and the cultivation of revolutionary ethics; and demonstrate sound political and ideological awareness in academic work and practical activities.
Nâng cao ý thức rõ hơn về trách nhiệm công dân trước những nhiệm vụ trọng đại của đất nước Raise higher sense of civic responsibility over important duties of the country

Xây dựng phương pháp tư duy khoa học về lịch sử; kỹ năng lựa chọn và tổng hợp tài liệu nghiên cứu, học tập; phát triển kỹ năng làm việc cá nhân và nhóm; ứng dụng công nghệ, đặc biệt là AI một cách có đạo đức và trách nhiệm để hỗ trợ nghiên cứu và học tập; đồng thời nâng cao kỹ năng thuyết trình và trình bày sản phẩm, kết quả nghiên cứu gắn với chủ trương của Đảng Develop scientific thinking methods in history; acquire skills in selecting and synthesizing research and learning materials; strengthen individual and group work skills; apply technology, especially AI, in an ethical and responsible manner to support research and learning; and enhance presentation skills in delivering research products and outcomes in line with the Party’s guidelines.

Vận dụng nhận thức lịch sử và thực tiễn để nhận diện, phân tích và chủ động phê phán quan niệm sai trái về lịch sử của Đảng Apply historical and practical knowledge to identify, analyze, and proactively criticize false perceptions of the Party’s history.

Vận dụng quan điểm của Đảng vào cuộc sống và công tác, biết kết hợp với những kiến thức chuyên ngành để chủ động, tích cực giải quyết những thực tiễn đặt ra theo đường lối, chính sách, pháp luật của Đảng và Nhà nước Apply the Party's viewpoints to life and work, combine it with specialized knowledge to proactively solve problems in reality in accordance with the guidelines, policies and laws of the Party and State

metadata.title: Investment Portfolio_Quản lý danh mục đầu tư
metadata.description:
-Students will learn the essential skills of portfolio management and personal investing, learn how to think about, discuss, and formulate solutions to common investor's questions, issues: how to meet their liabilities, how to decide where to invest, and how much risk to take on. Students will learn the theory and the real-world skills necessary to design, execute, and evaluate investment proposals that meet financial objectives.
-Students will then learn how to construct optimal portfolios that manage risk effectively, and how to capitalize on understanding behavioral biases and irrational behavior in financial markets. Students will learn the best practices in portfolio management and performance evaluation as well as current investment strategies. By the end of Capstone Project, students will have mastered the analytical tools, quantitative skills, and practical knowledge necessary for long-term investment management success.
Note: Students who complete all MOOCs before the course deadline will receive 1 bonus point; otherwise, no bonus point will be awarded.

5. Attend off-line sessions in the Campus (Optional)
6. Must complete all MOOCs of spec. with certification in order to take the Final Exam at Campus

metadata.title: Mergers and Acquisitions - Mua bán và Sáp nhập
metadata.description:
This course provides students with knowledge on how to apply advanced analysis to the valuation of companies involved in the mergers and acquisitions process. Students will gain an overview of the private equity industry and the practical issues involved in leveraged buyouts and buy-ins. Students will also gain an understanding of the tools and techniques used in the valuation of a company, and a complete overview of key elements in successful M&A and private equity transactions.
- Teaching method: Lecturing, in-class assignment, problem-based discussions, and team-based activities.
metadata.student_tasks:
- Students must attend at least 80% of contact slots in order to be accepted to the final examination.
- Student is responsible to do all exerciand ses, assignments given by instructors in class or at home and submit on time
- Use laptop in class only for learning purposes

learning_outcomes.details: Explain the rationale behind the M&A environment.
Identify the tactics of hostile takeovers and define antitakeover measures.
Develop integrative, adaptive planning frameworks for use before, during and after a negotiation by applying a thorough understanding of negotiation concepts, theories and principles.
Apply industry-accepted valuation methods (DCF, relative valuation) to analyse merger, acquisition and related transactions.
Practice ability to work as part of an effective team to prepare a financial valuation and a negotiation plan
Demonstrate the ability to produce a clear oral report and/or academic written report, which follows research ethic, that applies understanding of key concepts in M&A.

assessments.note:
- Guided by instructor
- Example of group assignment:
Acquisition Team Project: Early in the term students will divide into “teams” of four-to-six students each to share the research, analysis, and field work required to design a viable corporate acquisition proposal. The purpose of the Acquisition Project is to give students the opportunity to apply the tools they have learned in an increasingly common situation, i.e., mergers and acquisitions.

Each team will be asked to represent an acquiring company or investment group whose business strategy involves an acquisition or merger. The acquiring and target firms must be in the same industry. The acquisition can involve a recent transaction (i.e., last 12 to 18 months), a current transaction, or a hypothetical transaction involving two publicly traded firms, private companies, or some combination. The use of publicly traded companies will facilitate data collection, and the selection of companies in the same industry will simplify the analysis by eliminating the need to analyze two different industries.

Selecting Companies to Study: The success of the Project will be greatly dependent on the Team’s ability to understand the company’s operations, products, and the competitive dynamics of the industry in which it competes and to obtain financial, technical and market-related information on the company. Teams are encouraged (but not required) to select a publicly traded company, because both internal financial and operating data, as well as market/industry data, is likely to be more readily available (e.g., through Disclosure, Value Line, Standard & Poors Corporate Register, Thomas Register, etc.) than for a privately owned firm.

metadata.title: Technical Analysis_Phân tích kỹ thuật
metadata.description:
This course aims to introduce students to understand the basic of technical analysis and how to apply it to investment.
After the class, students have ability to use technical analysis to evaluate and predict the future price movement of financial assets, such as stocks, currencies, commodities, by analyzing historical price chart and trading volumes instead of focusing on the intrinsic value of an asset.
The course includes the following main topics: Charts and Parttens, Indicators, Candlestick Analysis, Market trends, Risk management.
metadata.student_tasks:
- Students must attend at least 80% of contact slots in order to be accepted to the final examination.
- Student is responsible to do all exercises, assignments and labs given by the instructor in class or at home and submit on time
- Use laptop in class only for learning purposes
- Promptly access to http://flm.fpt.edu.vn for up-to-date course information

learning_outcomes.details: Analyze the foundations of technical analysis
Understand the main principles of technical analysis
Understand the principles of chart analysis with proficient skills in identifying chart patterns, market trends, support and resistance levels
Proficient in drawing and interpreting stock market focasting trendlines with Fibonacci sequences, Dow Theory and other theories
Proficient in using moving averages, RSI, MACD, and other key technical indicators in analyzing price movements and trading signals
Formulate trading strategies and evaluate the risks and rewards based on technical analysis
Make appropriate decisions by considering technical analysis, fundamental analysis, and other forms of market analysis

metadata.course_name_from_curriculum: Behavioral Finance_Tài chính hành vi
metadata.combo_name_from_curriculum: CF_COM1: Investment Finance _Tài chính đầu tư
metadata.title: Behavioral finance_Tài chính hành vi
metadata.description:
This course aims to introduce students to behavioral theories of finance and financial decision making. Behavioral foundations including biases; heuristics; and
framing effects, will be examined. It then can compare and contrast rational and behavioral theories of finance and financial decision making. This extends students’ knowledge of finance
by demonstrating how “real” investors and markets do not always correspond to the rational agents and outcomes described in standard finance courses.
metadata.student_tasks:
- Students must attend at least 80% of contact slots in order to be accepted to the final examination.
- Student is responsible to do all exercises, assignments and labs given by instructor in class or at home and submit on time
- Use laptop in class only for learning purpose
- Promptly access to http://flm.fpt.edu.vn for up-to-date course information

materials.description: Behavioral Finance Psychology, Decision-Making, and Markets, 1st  Edition
materials.author: Lucy Ackert, Richard Deaves

learning_outcomes.details: Critically review the foundations of conventional finance;
Have a good understand of the main principles of cognitive psychology as applied in behavioural finance;
Understand the causes and nature of market anomalies;
Critically evaluate behavioural influences involving individuals’ securities pricing, financial analysis, investment decisions.
Critically evaluate behavioural influences involving corporate (executive) financial decisions.
Apply the knowledge of behavioural finance to improve investment and corporate performance.
Develop strategies to manage wealth effectively and wisely in inefficient financial markets such as mispriced assets, shocks, news.
Shows self-reliance when working independently and collaboratively
Demonstrate ethical awareness and reflection in business context

metadata.combo_name_from_curriculum: CF_COM2: Corporate Finance - Tài chính doanh nghiệp
metadata.title: Financial Reporting_Báo cáo tài chính
metadata.description:
The Financial Reporting Specialization focuses on the role of financial accounting principles and processes in creating and reporting an organization’s financial statements. Learners who complete this specialization will be able to (1) use financial accounting principles to create and/or process an organization’s financial statements and (2) analyze financial statements to assess an organization’s financial position.
Note: Students who complete all MOOCs before the course deadline will receive 1 bonus point; otherwise, no bonus point will be awarded.
metadata.student_tasks:
1. Join the online course (spec.) when being invited by the admin.
2. Enroll in each MOOC of spec., regularly study MOOCs at least 5hrs/week by watching videos, reading materials, taking quizzes, doing assgnments... as required
3. Respect the Coursera Code of Conduct, at https://learner.coursera.help/hc/en-us/articles/208280036-Coursera-Code-of-Conduct
3. Keep online learning progress promptly (bonus will be awarded)
4. Communicate and discuss in forum
5. Attend off-line sessions in the Campus (Optional)
6. Must complete all MOOCs of spec. with certification in order to take the Final Exam at Campus

materials.note: MOOC 1: Accounting Analysis I: The Role of Accounting as an Information System
MOOC 2: Accounting Analysis I: Measurement and Disclosure of Assets
MOOC 3: Accounting Analysis II: Measurement and Disclosure of Liabilities
MOOC 4: Accounting Analysis II: Accounting for Liabilities and Equity

learning_outcomes.details: Using financial accounting principles to create and/or process an organization’s financial statements.
Ability to combine the concepts and techniques obtained through all the courses in this specialization.
Apply the concepts and techniques obtained through all the courses in this specialization to a real world accounting project.
Practising the project
Analyzing financial statements to assess an organization’s financial position.
Explain the accounting concepts, principles and theory with an emphasis on problems that arise in applying these concepts for external reporting purposes.
Measuring of assets, liabilities, equities and income, as well as disclosure of additional information that may assist users understand the financial reports.
Identify the current liabilities and contingencies and continues with long-term debt and bonds.
Explain the accounting model for leases, both lessees and lessors.
Explain the deferred tax assets and liabilities.
Explain the recognition, measurement and subsequent accounting for equity, pensions, share-based compensation.
Explain the cash flows utilizing the FASB Accounting Standards Codification and other resources

metadata.title: International Corporate Finance_Tài chính doanh nghiệp quốc tế
metadata.description: This course provides basic knowledge of concepts and analytical techniques in international corporate finance, why MNCs make capital expenditures in productive capacity in foreign lands, how to manage cash in MNCs, and how to apply them to international market transactions nowadays. These include the ability to understand the governance of multinational corporations, and their investing, financing, and risk management decisions in a perspective of maximizing the value to their shareholders.

- Students must attend at least 80% of contact slots in order to be accepted to the final examination.

- Use laptop in class only for learning purpose
- Promptly access to the FU CMS at http://flm.fpt.edu.vn for up-to-date course information

metadata.description: The goal of this course is to provide students with fundamental knowledge of taxation as well as a framework for understanding how taxes influence company decisions. Topics to be covered include: Fundamentals of taxation, Personal Income Tax, Corporate Income Tax, Value Added Tax (VAT), Foreign Contractor Taxes, Excise Duty, Custom Duty, Other Taxes in Vietnam and International Taxation.

learning_outcomes.details: Remembering the tax systems and Vietnamese legal framework for taxation.
Understanding the nature and function of the Vietnamese tax system in society.
Applying legal framework to compute the company's tax liabilities of companies.
Analyzing tax policies and potential tax advantages for various organizations.
Evaluating tax strategy of companies.
Developing a compliance mindset and an awareness of self-updating new tax prerequisites.
Creating an effective tax strategy for the company.
Show the ability of interpersonal communication in business context

metadata.title: Financial Risk Management _ Quản trị rủi ro tài chính
metadata.description: Financial Risk Management course explains all aspects of financial risk and financial institution regulation, helping you better understand the financial markets—and their potential dangers. Inside, you’ll learn the different types of risk, how and where they appear in different types of institutions, and how the regulatory structure of each institution affects risk management practices.
metadata.student_tasks:
* Students must attend at least 80% of contact slots in order to be accepted to the final examination.
* Student is responsible to do all exercises, assignments given by instructors in class or at home and submit on time
* Use laptop in class only for learning purpose
* Promptly access to http://flm.fpt.edu.vn for up-to-date course information

materials.description: Risk Management and Financial Institutions, Decision-Making, and Markets
materials.author: John C. Hull

learning_outcomes.details: Articulate applicability of conduct risk in various types of financial institutions, its drivers and mitigation techniques
Classify and comprehend core risk measurement and management tools to a variety of risks faced by institutions
Evaluate key risks applicable to financial institutions using core risk measurement tools
Evaluate the effectiveness of the risk monitoring frameworks used by financial institutions
Identify and articulate the key aspects of Basel (II, and III) framework and the shortcomings of the Basel Frameworks.
Shows self-reliance when working independently and collaboratively
Demonstrate ethical awareness and reflection in business context

metadata.title: Digital Marketing Strategy_Chiến lược marketing số
metadata.description:
Description: This course is based on the Coursera Specialization "Digital Marketing," offering a comprehensive exploration of the dynamics and global aspects of digital marketing. Students will delve into how the Digital Revolution has impacted marketing in an Analog World and gain insights into the core processes of planning and executing a digital marketing campaign.
Additionally, the course integrates the use of artificial intelligence (AI) to equip students with essential skills for market data collection, consumer behavior analysis, and effective digital marketing strategy development. By the end of the course, students will be able to select the most suitable marketing channels for various products and design impactful AI-powered digital campaigns.
*Teaching Method: This blended-learning course combines self-paced online study with collaborative in-class activities. Students are required to review videos, slides, and readings on Coursera before class. During class sessions, they will review key content and engage with peers and instructors to reinforce and apply their knowledge.
metadata.student_tasks:
Student Tasks:
- Access the learning materials on Coursera for self-study purposes
- Attend at least 80% of contact hours to be eligible for the final assessment
- Actively participate in class activities
- Fulfill tasks given by the instructor after class
- Apply AI tools responsibly and ethically in assigned exercises
- Use their laptop in class only for learning purposes
- Access http://flm.fpt.edu.vn for up-to-date course information

learning_outcomes.details: Understand how digital tools are changing the nature of marketing in basic
Explain clearly how digital tools allow consumers to take a more active role in product development, promotion, placement, and pricing activities
Obtain a new set of concepts, tools, and stories to enhance your digital marketing efforts effectively
Understand the strategic impacts of digital media and information technologies on communication and marketing
Apply the concepts, tools, and knowledge provided to formulate a digital marketing plan
Shows self-reliance when working independently and collaboratively
Demonstrate ethical awareness and reflection in business context
Understand how to apply AI technologies to collect information and create effective digital marketing strategies

metadata.title: Content Marketing_Marketing Nội dung
metadata.description:
This Course is based on the both Coursera Specialization "The Strategy of Content Marketing" and "Social Media Management", which covers both the theorical and practical lessons of content marketing. You firstly will learn the core strategies content marketers use to acquire and retain customers profitably. Specifically, you will learn how to develop, organize and implement a content marketing strategy, analyze and measure the effectiveness of content marketing, write compelling copy, use a strategic framework when writing, and build your professional brand and authority through content marketing. You will also learn how to put the ideas presented to you into action and build your own personal brand through content marketing. You will end the course with real-world application of your skills through a content management project on social media.
This is a blended-learning course, in which students will take a look at the videos & slides and reading on Coursera first at home, then rewatch & discuss key questions with classmates and teachers at classes.
AI tools can significantly enhance content marketing efforts by automating tasks, improving content quality, and providing valuable insights. Some AI tools that can be used in content marketing include:
AI Writing Tools, AI Design Tools, AI Social Media Management Tools, AI Analytics Tools

assessments.note:
(Suggestion only) Students will find an example of a web-based content marketing effort for a company, product, service or non-profit organization to present to the class. This example will include a blog and a variety of social media efforts. Photography, video, podcasts, newsletters and/or tutorials and guides may also be elements of the content marketing effort. Students will create a 15-minute presentation that will identify and assess the effectiveness of the following:
The Mission Statement
The Primary Goals
The Core Message and Two Secondary Messages The Target Audience/Niche
Customer Benefits
The Unique Proposition
Slogans and Taglines
The Publication Schedule

Students are also encouraged to complete and submit their certificate of Meta Social Media Marketing specialization by the end of the course.

metadata.description:
Learners will get accustomed to different valuable sales techniques, which guide them to prepare for sales activities, create better relationship with customers, utilize IT in sales management and deal with key accounts of their business.
As for sales perspectives, the course brings about the important roles of sales in company's marketing strategy, and helps learners shape their own sales strategy for any kind of given products.
Besides, four chapters in sales environment will also help learners consider various significant issues inside and outside their daily tasks such as, sales setting, customer behaviours, legal aspects and selling internationally.
metadata.student_tasks:
- 80% attendance is required.
- Students are expected to finish all the homework and prepare carefully for their next lessons. No late homework or submit on behalf of someone else will be accepted.
- With possible written assignments, students may use the work of others – textbooks, journal articles, the Internet and other sources to study and to prepare their assignments. In that case, they need to cite these sources in Harvard Referencing style.
- Take part in the final exam

learning_outcomes.details: Understand the importance of selling skills and sales planning process
Understand target customers' behaviors, sales settings and international selling
Master selling techniques and develop personal selling skills
Understand how to manage the key accounts
Best utilize relationship selling and direct marketing
Apply Internet and IT advancements in selling and sales management

metadata.description:
This Course is based on the Coursera Specialization "Digital Marketing" and Google Digital Marketing & E-commerce Certificat Professionnel, which covers both the dynamics and the global aspects of digital marketing. You'll learn how to attract customers using various digital channels, measure marketing performance through analytics, and manage e-commerce stores to boost customer loyalty.
*Teaching method: This is a blended-learning course, in which students will take a look at the videos & slides and reading on Coursera first at home, then rewatch & discuss key questions with classmates and teachers at classes.
Students will use AI tools and applications to:
- support generating and refining ideas
- assist in content suggestions,
- assist in answering questions on Edunext, in-class discussions, and identifying credible sources.
- supports summarizing and concluding research findings through data-driven insights and structured templates.

metadata.title: Google Ads and SEO - Google Ads và SEO
metadata.description: This course is designed to teach students to optimize website content for the best possible search engine ranking. Students will learn the theory behind Google search and other search engine algorithms, as well as build practical, real-world skills that can be applied to a career in digital marketing or online content development, including on-page and off-page optimization, optimizing for local and international audiences, conducting search-focused website audits, and aligning SEO with overall business strategies. Students will also learn how to create and execute search campaigns on Google Ads Search (formally AdWords). Through an introductory overview, students are guided through the official Google Ads Search training materials. Beyond Google materials, practical campaign creation and optimization best practices and exercises are provided to ensure the acquisition of practical skills and knowledge.

metadata.title: Social Media Marketing_Marketing mạng xã hội
metadata.description: The Social Media Marketing Specialization is designed to achieve two objectives. It gives students the social analytics tools, and training to help them become an influencer on social media. The course also gives the knowledge and resources to build a complete social media marketing strategy – from consumer insights to final justification metrics.
metadata.student_tasks: Access the specialization on Coursera and complete all courses' requirements to earn a certificate of completion for the specialization, in order to be qualified for the Final Exam.
metadata.note: Ongoing assessment: Students who complete all MOOCs before the course deadline will receive 1 bonus point; otherwise, no bonus point will be awarded.

learning_outcomes.details: Understand how to grow your social strategy using effective, proven methodologies.
Understand the Big Data of social and gain a more complete picture of what can be learned from interactions on social sites.

Understand two of the most effective social strategies used by organizations today to reach your target consumer markets, and know when it is best to either use or avoid specific social marketing strategies.
Understand a thoughtful, integrated approach to make content that stands out in our increasingly oversaturated world.

Understand how to transform your organization's social marketing from an untracked investment to an integral part of your company’s marketing strategy, and the legal considerations involved as well as proven performance metrics and management tactics for success.
Understand how to use methodologies, tools, and insights you have learned to create a multifaceted plan to assure effective social marketing as an integral part of your business strategy.

metadata.description: Introduction to International Business is designed to equip students with a comprehensive understanding of the fundamental principles and practices of conducting business in a globalized economy. It explores the dynamic interplay of socio-cultural, economic, technological, and political-legal factors that shape the international business environment. Students will gain insights into the strategies and techniques for entering and operating in foreign markets, including trade policies, global supply chains, and cross-border management. A key feature of this course is the integration of artificial intelligence (AI) tools and applications, enabling students to analyze international market trends, optimize decision-making processes, and develop innovative solutions to real-world business challenges. By the end of the course, students will be prepared to navigate the complexities of international business with a forward-thinking, technology-driven approach.

learning_outcomes.details: Recognize the key issues of globalization, and the national differences in political, economic, legal systems and culture
Apply AI to analyze global market trends and consumer sentiment, optimize solutions, and critically address bias, risks, and ethical responsibilities.

Demonstrate understanding about the ethical, corporate social responsibility, and sustainability faced by international business, and explaination how global managers can incorporate such issues into their decision making
Demonstrate understanding about the global trade and investment environment in which international business occurs
Describe characteristics of the foreign exchange market, different theories relating to exchange rate and how to manage foreign exchange risks
Identify the different global strategies and entry modes that firms use to compete in the global marketplace

Explain how firms can perform their key functions including global production, global supply chain management, global marketing, global research and development to compete and succeed in the international business environment
Evaluate external environment of a specific foreign market
Propose the suitable entry mode for a specific company to enter foreign market.
Demonstrate attitude to adapt to differences and complex issues in doing international business

metadata.description:
This course explores the effect of cultural differences on organisational behaviour and negotiation in the global context. It exposes students to issues and problems that inevitably arise in international business when managers have to deal with culturally determined differences in values, attitudes and behaviours.
The course assists students in developing cross-cultural communication competence and management and negotiation skills to successfully solve problems and capitalise on opportunities in a multicultural environment.
metadata.student_tasks:
-Students must attend at least 80% of contact slots in order to be accepted to the final examination.
-Student is responsible to do all exercises, assignments and labs given by instructor in class or at home and submit on time
-Use laptop in class only for learning purpose

learning_outcomes.details: Describe cultural dimensions based on cultural frameworks and apply them to global business settings.
Identify different negotiation scenarios, then formulate and apply the instruments of negotiation strategy and tactics.
Develop cultural intelligence to interact and manage people from different cultures.
Developing capability to competently apply course concepts in cross- cultural situations that require responses at the individual, managerial and organisational levels.

Identify the major dimensions of culture relevant to work settings and discuss their effect on behavior in an international environment. Describe negotiation styles in different cultures; adjust negotiation tactics to cultural differences.
Explain the motivation, leadership and HR selection across cultures.
Develop cultural sensitivity needed to succeed in any kind of cross-cultural interactions.
Differentiate the different types of negotiation approaches (integrative, distributive negotiations).
Describe the strategies and actions taken on different stages of negotiations; appreciate and explain the importance of pre-; during and post-negotiation phases.
List the roles and functions in negotiation teams; demonstrate the skills of organizing and managing negotiation teams.

metadata.title: Supply Chain Management_Quản lý chuỗi cung ứng
metadata.description:
A supply chain is comprised of all the parties involved in fulfilling a customer request. The integrated management of this network is a critical determinant of success in today’s competitive environment.
Supply chain management is the systemic, strategic coordination of the traditional business functions within a particular company and across businesses within a supply chain, for the purpose of improving the long-term performance of the individual companies and the supply chain as a whole. The major supply chain processes include planning, sourcing, making or converting, fulfillment, and relationships management. The major dimensions for evaluating the performance of supply chain processes and activities are time, cost, quality and compliance. This course covers the major activities of companies involved in profitably coordinating supply and demand in the marketplace to deliver consumer value.

learning_outcomes.details: Understand basic terminology and supply chain operations in the context of today’s business environment
Describe purchasing work from a total cost perspective
Analyse a purchasing process and suggest improvements
Align the supply management and enterprise objectives
Apply methods relating to time, quality and costs in order to improve the efficiency of purchasing process and increase the competitiveness of the supply chain
Recognise the supplier selection process and apply the Six Sigma in supplier quality management
Recognize the important relationship between inventory management and delivering the perfect customer order
Apply lean and just in time thinking within a supply chain
Explain the importance of collaboration and integration within supply chains, and be able to account for different tools for this
Explain the purchasing function’s field of responsibility
Explain different models and strategies for purchasing

metadata.title: International Economics_Kinh tế quốc tế
metadata.description: This course will study the economic relations among nations through analyzing the exchange of goods, services as well as the linkages between trade, labor and capital movements, international fragmentation of production, economic well-being and the income distribution and to identify and critically examine policy implications of these linkages. Besides that, the course provides students both classical and modern theories of international trade in goods and services, as well as empirical research on trade . A substantial fraction of the course is dedicated to examination of efficient trade policies. This course also covers the balance of payments, exchange rates and open-economy macroeconomics.

learning_outcomes.details: Recognize the overview of world trade, cause of trade, the pattern of word trade, the way of word trade has evolved over time
Demonstrate the global capital market: performance and policy problems
Identify the idea of optimum currency areas
Demonstrate the understanding of Growth, Crises and International Speculation
Identify the the main Traditional Models of International Trade
Understand the Imperfect Competition and New Theories of International Trade

State the linkages between trade, labor and capital movements, international fragmentation of production, economic well-being and the income distribution and to identify and critically examine policy implications of these linkages
Identify International factor mobility
Analyze instruments and consequences of trade policy measures

Discuss the political economy of Trade Policy: the motivation for protectionist policies, examples of current trade agreements, Recent controversies in trade policy and trade retaliation, Trade policy in developing countries, links between trade and the environment.
Understand the exchange Rates, Price Levels and Money
Analyze clearly the intertemporal approach to current account, balance of payments and the trade balance;

metadata.course_name_from_curriculum: International Payment_Thanh toán quốc tế
metadata.combo_name_from_curriculum: CF_COM5: International Business_Kinh doanh quốc tế
metadata.title: International Payment_Thanh toán quốc tế
metadata.description:
This course is designed to provide students with a deep understanding of international payment including: parties to the international payment transaction; four primary payment methods: documentary letters of credit, documentary collections, pre-payment and credit transactions with detail description of documentary letters of credit (both standard and special letters of credit) and documentary collections; payment currency; ... It also covers: foreign exchange (forward contracts); documents used in trade; Letter of credit application and instructions; trade terms (Incoterms 2020); Cyber transaction on the Internet.
Topics mainly include: (1) Key Issues in International Payments. (2) Buyer and the Seller. (3) Basic Terms of Payment (4) Foreign Exchange (5) Various trade terms (Incoterms 2010). (6) Drafts and Acceptances. (7) Documentary Collections. (8) Documentary Credits. (9) Document and Document Checklists. (10) Cyberpayments.
AI Tools will be used to support students in
(1) generating ideas/structures for their speaking notes and slide structure of 4 important topics of the course: Incoterms, International contract, Documentary Collection, and Documentary Credits; and for their group presentation topic.
(2) editing the slide set after students have already finished it.
metadata.student_tasks:
- Attend at least 80% of contact hours in order to be accepted to the final examination
- Actively participate in class activities
- Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class
- Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose
- Read the textbook in advance

materials.description: A Short Course in International Payments
materials.author: Edward G. Hinkelman

learning_outcomes.details: Understand the key concepts of international trade and international payment
Introduce the parties to a documentary collection, describe process and analyze advantages and disadvantages of documentary collection
Utilize URC 522 to a documentary collection
Categorize three types of collections
Perceive the important principles regarding the role of banks
Discuss about notes, tips, and cautions for sellers, buyers and banks
Classify types of credits basic
Utilize UCP600 to a documentary credits
Understand regarding the role of banks in documentary credits and settlement by payment
Understand and distinguish the standard credits
Understand and distinguish the special letters of credit
Distinguish international payment with domestic payment
Discuss about notes, tips, and cautions for sellers, buyers and banks in documentary credits
Understand and construct documents (commercial invoice, bill of lading, insurance document, certificate of origin, packing list, inspection certificate...)
Apply document checklists
Define cyberpayments, electronic commerce, secure electronic transaction standards.
Understand the business concerns of the buyer and seller and how these concerns affect decisions relating to which payment method is used in an international transaction.
Identify the key factors in determining the payment method
Distinguish international payment methods
Understand and analyze the currency in international payment and foreign exchange risk.
Identify the drafting of a contract, performance or modification of contractual obligations, resolution of disputes, and enforcement of judgments or orders.
Distinguish the before finalize a contract.
Understand the formal definition of draft, acceptances, holding or discounting acceptances.

metadata.prerequisites: MKT101 or MKG101 or MMK101 or IBI101
metadata.description: This Specialization covers marketing concepts but, more importantly, emphasizes the need by companies and individuals to think openly across international markets and industries for new ideas or expansion. This is summarized as "Cross Country & Cross Industry" Innovation, or CCCI in short. The first two courses will establish the core foundations and then the last three courses will elaborate on major global industry clusters: course 3 on B2B, course 4 on Healthcare and Hospitality, and course 5 on Sports and Entertainment. The capstone will require learners to develop a new product using knowledge learned from at least 2 industries.
metadata.student_tasks:
1. Join the online course (spec.) when being invited by the admin.
2. Enroll in each MOOC of spec., regularly study MOOCs at least 5hrs/week by watching videos, reading materials, taking quizzes, doing assgnments... as required
3. Respect the Coursera Code of Conduct, at https://learner.coursera.help/hc/en-us/articles/208280036-Coursera-Code-of-Conduct
3. Keep online learning progress promptly (bonus will be awarded)
4. Communicate and discuss in forum
5. Attend off-line sessions in the Campus (Optional)
6. Must complete all MOOCs of spec. with certification in order to take the Final Exam at Campus
metadata.note: Ongoing assessment: Students who complete all MOOCs before the course deadline will receive 1 bonus point; otherwise, no bonus point will be awarded.

learning_outcomes.details: Understand the basic foundations of international marketing and be able to explain how companies can grow by going abroad or sourcing ideas/expanding into other countries or industries.

Understand consumer science investigation, B2C marketing, International Marketing Entry, Targeting, Positioning, International Product, International Promotion, International Place and International Price
Understand the differentiating aspects of business to business (B2B) marketing that can be contrasted to traditional business to consumer (B2C) marketing
Understand the unique characteristics of both hospitality and healthcare services sector.
Understand the characteristics and marketing strategies related to two key global industries, sports and entertainment.
Be able to apply what you have learned during the 16 weeks of the 5 courses
